purpose: Reconstruct the installed package and existing local Python/R probe on a second owned Mac, not a scientific study or researcher efficacy result.

host_condition.observation: Verified owner SSH host key; 63 percent memory free, 217.31 MiB swap used and about 15 GiB disk free before admission. These are not idle-host or available-RAM guarantees.

execution: Commit this plan and the reconstruction driver before archive transfer or installation.
Archive only the named tracked source members at source_commit. Transfer no credentials, old environment, caches, node_modules, results, textbook assets or Lean artifacts.
Use the existing observed Python/Node/uv binaries, a fresh venv/HOME and empty uv/npm caches. No new system toolchain, model server, VM, proxy or global setting.
Build a wheel without cloud/proof extras; install the wheel with the declared Python dependencies. Preserve resolved build dependency/log identities without claiming a fully locked build toolchain.
Run npm ci --omit=dev and the unchanged scientific preparation command, permitting only these required public dependency downloads.
Run installed CLI help/list/doctor and the unchanged synthetic two-file Python/R positive/raw-failure probe from an empty researcher directory.

Retain every stage command, environment, PID/start identity, raw output, exit/time and artifact hashes. Stop at the first failed stage; no alternative backend, package-version substitution or same-condition retry.
Copy records back and remove only the owned remote temporary tree after verified retrieval. Preserve the local raw record; never stop peer work.

resource_envelope.limits: Wall-clock timeouts terminate only the owned process group. Disk is checked after stages, not continuously capped; Node old-space is not an RSS limit. Existing probe has its own 60-second execution timeouts.

limits: Fresh installation on another existing Mac is not a factory-reset machine, broad OS support or a full model-driven researcher workflow.
MacOS, Python and Node differ from the earlier same-machine check and remain separate conditions, not replicates of that installation.
No model inference, native-R/Lean validation, scientific result, official draw or publication readiness follows from the probe.
Root/third-party rights, researcher usability, independent mathematical assessment and comparative efficacy remain unresolved.
